notes: Original acquisition terminal miss recorded at texts/21ae3ca30ea09cd7c1aecb17.miss (DOI, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, and archive routes unsuccessful); no original statistics copied from secondary reproduced F&K columns. Replication coefficient is printed, while a coefficient-specific t/z test statistic is not printed; parenthesized numbers are Newey-West standard errors, not test statistics. J-test chi-square and p-values test instrument validity and are not the target coefficient test. No exact p-value or explicit numeric bound is printed for the target coefficient; absence of stars has not been converted to a numeric p bound. Reported success records the author’s explicit paper-wide verdict, not a coefficient-specific inferred verdict.
